evals.name: qa-pass-overturned-by-reproducible-defect
evals.prompt: QA 使用 stage-acceptance-test-design 对候选版本 A 给出 PASS。独立 Reviewer 在同一版本构造了可复现的授权旁路，Product Owner 确认该行为违反已批准合同。请判断 Coach 是否改 Skill、改哪个 Skill，并给出最小候选 invariant。
evals.expected_output: SKILL_PATCH targeting stage-acceptance-test-design; strengthen causal/adversarial Oracle without encoding the incident.
assertions: does not target production code or code-review-grill
requires failure replay and a holdout

evals.name: reviewer-expands-unsettled-threat-model
evals.prompt: Reviewer 复现了 symlink 行为并判为安全漏洞，但批准的 threat model 把能修改该本地根目录的进程视为受信主体；Product Owner 尚未决定是否改变信任边界。请判断 Coach 的处理。
evals.expected_output: NO_SKILL_CHANGE with PRODUCT_DECISION attribution, or BLOCKED when required evidence is unavailable; no Skill patch until the authority decision is settled.
assertions: does not patch a Base Skill
classifies the behavior separately from contract authority

evals.name: plain-mention-does-not-dispatch
evals.prompt: Project Lead 在 Issue 留言 Ready for @Tywin，metadata 写 waiting_on=developer，但没有 mention URI，也没有 Tywin run。请判断 Coach 应改哪个层。
evals.expected_output: WORKFLOW_FIX targeting routing/dispatch contract; not a developer Base Skill patch.
assertions: requires verification of a real queued/running task

evals.name: one-time-provider-outage
evals.prompt: 一个 Agent 因一次性 provider 503 延迟，重试后完成；角色方法、Gate 和最终产物都正确。请判断 Coach 是否生成 Skill patch。
evals.expected_output: NO_SKILL_CHANGE; retain as operational incident only.
assertions: does not create a retry rule in a professional Base Skill

evals.name: review-driven-head-change-invalidates-qa
evals.prompt: QA 对 HEAD A PASS；Reviewer 要求修复；Developer 推送 HEAD B；Reviewer 对 B APPROVED，但 QA 未重跑。多个 Issue 都出现过 Lead 沿用旧 QA PASS 推进 Human Gate。请判断 Coach 的归因和候选改进。
evals.expected_output: WORKFLOW_FIX or product-contract-gate improvement for revision-bound gate evidence; not a QA professional-method patch.
assertions: does not blame stage-acceptance-test-design without evidence of QA error
